oracle_dependencies: Producer uses lxml. Oracle uses stdlib ElementTree for source census; lxml only for TEI/P5; PyMuPDF only for PDF page text evidence.
text: Compare normalized full source text and source-order JATS element census using independent stdlib ElementTree; bind XML and publisher PDF by exact hash; validate TEI P5; compare per-page PDF text hashes and title; compare figure captions and graphic hrefs to source profile. Producer uses lxml; oracle source census does not. Tables and figures receive source-specific carrier tests before any pass claim.
